description: This Java class implements a handler that enforces non-null void reasons on specific OpenMRS domain objects (Patient, Encounter, Obs, Cohort, Order). It ensures that these objects are voided with an explanatory reason, throwing exceptions if the reason is missing or blank.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class for ensuring void reasons are provided before voiding domain objects such as Patient, Encounter, Obs, Cohort, and Order in OpenMRS.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Validates that the voidReason is non-null and non-empty for supported objects. Throws IllegalArgumentException if voidReason is blank.
